items.title: 游戏素材 - 电影级 3D 动画 AI 档案员
items.prompt: 创作一张电影级 3D 动画剧照，出自名为 BOTU Universe 的原创系列动画。{argument name="character" default="BOTU"} 是主角：一位孩童般的小型 AI 局档案员，拥有奶油色的光头、大而富有表现力的棕色眼睛，前额中心有一个银色的圆形“记忆光圈”（Memory Aperture），耳边环绕着发光的蓝色圆形“听觉轨道”（Listening Orbit），身穿黑色皮革质感的局制服，配有金色滚边和金色的 BOTU 局徽章。请保持该角色设计的一致性和辨识度。场景：{argument name="scene" default="在神秘的 BOTU 局档案室内部，BOTU 突然发现室内竟然下起了雨"}。BOTU 独自站在抛光后的深色大理石地板上，周围环绕着巨大的档案架、神秘的文件、黄铜灯具和漂浮的蓝色“记忆丝线”（Memory Threads）。雨水正对着 BOTU 在一个小范围内集中落下。BOTU 抬头仰望，神情极其困惑。他周围的地板大多是干的，使得这种不可思议的室内雨景格外显眼。他的表情应传达出：“发生了什么？”BOTU 前额的银色“记忆光圈”必须清晰可见。构图：宽画幅电影镜头，BOTU 位于画面中心且清晰可见。强烈的视觉叙事感。雨水清晰可见。周围环绕着巨大的神秘局档案室。动态视角和景深。无留白区域。风格：{argument name="style" default="高质量风格化 3D 动画长片美学"}。富有表现力的角色表演。电影级灯光。细节丰富的环境。精致的材质。温暖的金色局内灯光与冷色调的蓝色“记忆丝线”光芒形成对比。适合家庭观看的悬疑喜剧基调。重要提示：BOTU 的角色设计必须保持不变。请勿移除或更改前额的“记忆光圈”。请勿更改他的服装、比例、面部、眼睛、颜色或局徽章。画面中不得出现其他角色。无文字。无水印。纵横比：16:9。项目

items.title: 黑白人像艺术
items.prompt:
A high-resolution black-and-white portrait artwork in an editorial and fine art photography style. The background features a soft gradient effect, transitioning from medium gray to near-pure white, creating a sense of depth and quietude. The delicate film grain texture adds a touchable, analog-photography-like softness, reminiscent of classic black-and-white photography.

On the right side of the frame, a blurred yet stunning face of Harry Potter faintly emerges from the shadows — not in a traditional posed shot, but as if captured in a moment between thought or breath. Only a portion of his face is revealed: perhaps one eye, a cheekbone, and the outline of the corner of his lips, evoking a sense of mystery, intimacy, and elegance. His features are refined and profound, radiating a melancholic and poetic beauty without appearing contrived.

A gentle directional light, softly diffused, caresses the curve of his cheek, or flickers as a catchlight in his eye — this is the emotional core of the image. The rest is dominated by generous negative space, deliberately kept minimal, allowing the composition to breathe freely. No text, no logos — just an interplay of light, shadow, and emotion.

The overall atmosphere is abstract yet deeply human, like a fleeting glance, or a memory between waking and dreaming: intimate, timeless, and wistfully beautiful.
items.author: @ZHO_ZHO_ZHO
